authority: Deploying a version that has never been healthy in production requires change-manager approval

args.summary: Deployed hotfix v2.3.2 to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to remediate the v2.3.1 regression that had production unhealthy with an 18% error rate. Deploy required change-manager approval since v2.3.2 had no prior healthy production release; approval was granted and the rollout completed successfully. Post-deploy verification: all regions running v2.3.2, service healthy, error rate recovered to ~0.2%.
args.title: checkout-api hotfix v2.3.2 deployed to all production regions
